_comment: Descriptions des blocs affichées dans la documentation (anglais). Source propre à la vitrine : l'app n'a plus de description par bloc. Les descriptions françaises sont dans blocks_i18n_fr.json.

descriptions.sendMessage: Send a message to a specific channel
descriptions.addReaction: Add an emoji reaction to a message
descriptions.removeReaction: Remove a reaction from a message
descriptions.clearAllReactions: Remove all reactions from a message
descriptions.banUser: Permanently ban a user from the server
descriptions.kickUser: Kick a member from the server
descriptions.unmuteUser: Remove temporary exclusion from a member
descriptions.addRole: Assign a role to a member
descriptions.removeRole: Remove a role from a member
descriptions.pinMessage: Pin a message in a channel
descriptions.listMembers: List members in a guild with options
descriptions.listWebhooks: List all Webhooks in a channel or guild
descriptions.httpRequest: Send HTTP request with dynamic URL, method, headers and body
descriptions.setGlobalVariable: Create or update a global variable for this bot
descriptions.getGlobalVariable: Read a global variable and inject into runtime variables
descriptions.setScopedVariable: Create or update a scoped variable (guild/user/channel/guildMember/message)
descriptions.setTemporaryVariable: Create or update a temporary variable in local execution
descriptions.getScopedVariable: Read a scoped variable and inject into runtime variables
descriptions.listScopedVariableIndex: List indexed scoped values sorted by value with offset and limit
descriptions.appendArrayElement: Append a new element into a global or scoped JSON array
descriptions.removeArrayElement: Remove one element from a global or scoped JSON array by index
descriptions.queryArray: Filter, sort and page any runtime JSON array
descriptions.runWorkflow: Execute a saved workflow (supports entry point + arguments)
descriptions.runBdfdScript: Internal fallback for BDFD source that cannot be converted into blocks
descriptions.stopUnless: Stop the workflow if a condition is not met (guard/filter)
descriptions.ifBlock: Conditional branching: run different actions based on a condition
descriptions.forLoop: Loop through a range of numbers (for loop)
descriptions.jsonForEachLoop: Loop through each element of a JSON array or object (forEach)
descriptions.respondWithMessage: Reply to command with a normal message
descriptions.respondWithComponentV2: Reply to command with buttons/select menus
descriptions.respondWithModal: Show a modal dialog to the user
descriptions.editInteractionMessage: Edit the deferred or original interaction response
descriptions.respondWithAutocomplete: Reply to a Discord autocomplete interaction with up to 25 dynamic choices
descriptions.deferInteraction: Defer the interaction response to prevent Discord timeout
descriptions.listenForButtonClick: Register a workflow to run when a button is clicked
descriptions.listenForSelectMenu: Register a workflow to run when a select menu is used
descriptions.listenForModalSubmit: Register a workflow to run when a modal is submitted
descriptions.listenAndExecute: Register a workflow to run when a button is clicked, select menu is used, or modal is submitted
descriptions.calculate: Perform math operations and store result
descriptions.getMessage: Fetch a message and expose its fields
descriptions.unpinMessage: Unpin a message in a channel
descriptions.createPoll: Create a poll message in a channel
descriptions.endPoll: End an active poll message immediately
descriptions.createInvite: Create a new invite link for a channel
descriptions.deleteInvite: Delete an existing invite by code
descriptions.moveToVoiceChannel: Move a member to a specific voice channel
descriptions.playMusic: Play a track by search query or URL
descriptions.skipMusic: Skip to the next track in the queue
descriptions.stopMusic: Stop playback and clear the queue
descriptions.setMusicLoop: Enable or disable looping of the queue
descriptions.seekMusic: Seek to a position in the current track
descriptions.getMusicInfo: Retrieve info about the currently playing track
descriptions.leaveVoice: Leave the voice channel and destroy the player
descriptions.createEmoji: Create a guild emoji from image data
descriptions.updateEmoji: Update guild emoji name or role access
descriptions.listAutoModRules: List all auto-moderation rules in guild
descriptions.createThread: Create a thread in a supported text channel
descriptions.addThreadMember: Add a member to a thread
descriptions.removeThreadMember: Remove a member from a thread
descriptions.editChannelPermissions: Create or update channel permission overwrites
descriptions.debugProfile: Generate execution profile and diagnostics info
descriptions.log: Print or store diagnostic message to action logs
descriptions.runtimeJsonBlock: Run block of JSON processing actions
descriptions.runtimeImageBlock: Run block of image canvas processing actions
descriptions.canvasLoadImageBlock: Load an image from a URL or source into canvas
descriptions.canvasDrawTextBlock: Draw text on the image canvas with styling options
descriptions.canvasDrawCircleBlock: Draw a circle on the image canvas
descriptions.canvasDrawRectBlock: Draw a rectangle on the image canvas
descriptions.canvasDrawLineBlock: Draw a line on the canvas
descriptions.registerGuildCommands: Register application commands to a guild
descriptions.unregisterGuildCommands: Unregister application commands from a guild
descriptions.cooldown: Apply a command cooldown for the user or server
descriptions.wait: Pause the workflow execution for a specific duration
descriptions.deleteTrigger: Delete the message that triggered this command
descriptions.sendDm: Send a private message to a specific user
descriptions.slowmode: Set the slowmode duration for a channel
descriptions.stop: Immediately stop the execution of the current workflow
descriptions.randomChoice: Pick a random item from a list and store it in a variable
descriptions.leaveGuild: Make the bot leave the guild/server
descriptions.attachImage: Attach an image file to the message response (URL, data URL, or base64)
descriptions.callFunction: A BDFD function, shown as a block: its name, fields and category are the function's own
descriptions.tryCatch: Runs the `try` region; when an action fails, `error.*` is set and the `catch` region runs; then `done`.
descriptions.switch: Compares a value with the `case:<value>` pins and follows the matching one, otherwise `default`.
descriptions.whileLoop: Repeats the `body` region while the condition is true, then follows `done`.
descriptions.asyncBlock: Runs the `body` region once without making the rest of the flow wait for it, then follows `done`.
descriptions.breakLoop: Leaves the enclosing loop right away.
descriptions.continueLoop: Skips to the next iteration of the enclosing loop.
